confidenceHint.known: Compy read this directly on your PC.
confidenceHint.measured: Measured on this PC, before and after.

lesson.label: What Compy learned on this PC:

sessions.steadierNotFaster: Between these two sessions, 1% lows rose and the average barely moved: {{game}} got steadier, not faster.
sessions.fasterAndSteadier: Between these two sessions, both the average and the 1% lows rose: {{game}} got faster and steadier.
sessions.fasterNotSteadier: Between these two sessions, the average rose and the 1% lows barely moved: {{game}} got faster, not steadier.
sessions.steadierButSlower: Between these two sessions, 1% lows rose but the average fell: {{game}} got steadier but slower.
sessions.fasterButLessSteady: Between these two sessions, the average rose but 1% lows fell: {{game}} got faster but less steady.
sessions.lessSteadyNotSlower: Between these two sessions, 1% lows fell and the average barely moved: {{game}} got less steady, not slower.
sessions.slowerAndLessSteady: Between these two sessions, both the average and the 1% lows fell: {{game}} got slower and less steady.
sessions.slowerNotLessSteady: Between these two sessions, the average fell and the 1% lows barely moved: {{game}} got slower, not less steady.
sessions.steadier: Between these two sessions, 1% lows rose: {{game}} got steadier. The average wasn't compared.
sessions.lessSteady: Between these two sessions, 1% lows fell: {{game}} got less steady. The average wasn't compared.
sessions.tooNoisy: {{game}} swings a lot between sessions on your PC; Compy needs steadier sessions to judge.

licensePanel.title: License
licensePanel.freeVersion: You're on the free version. All of Compy's core — including everything safety-critical — is free.

attribution.otherRig_one: {{count}} Compy change in this window was made on another PC and is not counted here.
attribution.otherRig_other: {{count}} Compy changes in this window were made on another PC and are not counted here.
attribution.rigUnknown_one: {{count}} of these was recorded before Compy stamped which PC it was on, so it may not have been this one.
attribution.rigUnknown_other: {{count}} of these were recorded before Compy stamped which PC they were on, so they may not have been this one.
attribution.listTruncated: Compy's model lists only its newest {{shown}} of {{total}} recorded changes, so older changes in this window are not named here.

undoUnrecorded: The undo worked on Windows, but Compy couldn't save it to its history, so Applied & history may still list this change. Check the setting in Windows if unsure.

ledgerHealth.activeUnknown: unknown — Compy can't read its own record
ledgerHealth.activeUnchecked_one: {{count}} more couldn't be checked just now
ledgerHealth.activeUnchecked_other: {{count}} more couldn't be checked just now
ledgerHealth.activeChangesUnvouched: Compy can't promise every change here can be undone
ledgerHealth.trackedUnknown: unknown — not the same as nothing applied
ledgerHealth.unreadableTitle: Compy can't read its own record right now
ledgerHealth.unreadableBody: So this list isn't the whole story. Compy won't apply or undo anything until it can read the record again — it refuses rather than guessing at what's on your PC.
ledgerHealth.quarantinedTitle: Compy can't tell you everything it did
ledgerHealth.quarantinedBody: The record was damaged on an earlier run, so Compy set the original aside unopened instead of deleting it. Nothing was thrown away — but changes made before that point are missing from this list, and can't be undone from here.
ledgerHealth.attributionUnknown: Compy can't read its own record, so it can't say whether any of its changes are part of this result.
ledgerHealth.revealFile: Show me the file Compy set aside
